parse_table_name.description: How a `tables` string splits into name components. Warehouses name a table catalog.schema.table, so three parts are catalog, schema, and table; folding the outer parts into one schema would quote them as a single identifier containing a dot, which names a schema no warehouse has. More than three parts are refused because there is no fourth level to put them in. Errors are pinned as reason slugs; the wording belongs to each language.

cases.name: a bare name is just a table
two parts are schema and table
three parts are catalog, schema, and table
four parts have no level to go in
